transcript: Speaker A: Vardan sir, aapke to ghar se hi sab English mein baat karte honge? Tabhi to aapki English itni achhi hai. [Vardan sir, everyone in your house must be speaking in English since childhood? That's why your English is so good.] Speaker B: Behen, main UP ke ek gaon se hoon na to hamare ghar mein koi English bolta hai, na hi mere ghar mein kisi ko aati hai. [Sister, I am from a village in UP, neither does anyone speak English in our house, nor does anyone know it.] Speaker A: Kya baat kar rahe? Par angrezi bolte hue aap bilkul Delhi aur Mumbai wale hi lagte ho. [What are you saying? But while speaking English, you sound exactly like someone from Delhi or Mumbai.] Speaker B: Behen, mehnat karke seekhi hai. Ek app hai PW Talk, Physics Wallah pata hai na, unki hi app hai English bolne ke liye. Maine pehle kitabon se, YouTube se seekhne ki koshish ki thi, lekin kuch fayda nahi hua. Saare niyam yaad to ho jaate the, lekin jaise hi bolne ka samay aata tha to muh se tooti-phooti English hi nikalti thi. Par ye PW Talk app ekdam alag hai. Ek to isme reel jaise English sikhane wale chhote-chhote videos hain jisme bore bhi nahi hote hain. Aur ek AI English teacher hai, jise to saari English aati hai aur jo bol-bol kar aur aapko bulwa kar English sikhati hai. Yahi mujhe din mein jab bhi time milta hai, break mein, office se aate-jaate, nikal kar seekhne lagta hoon. Aur dekho, mahine bhar mein hi gaon ke is ladke ko log Delhi-Mumbai ka samajhne lage. [Sister, I learned it with hard work. There is an app called PW Talk, you know Physics Wallah, right? It's their app for speaking English. I tried learning from books and YouTube earlier, but it was of no use. I would memorize all the rules, but when it came to speaking, only broken English came out. But this PW Talk app is totally different. First, it has short reel-like videos to teach English so you don't get bored. And there is an AI English teacher who knows all of English and teaches you by speaking and making you speak. Whenever I get time during the day, in breaks, while commuting to and from office, I start learning. And look, within a month, people started thinking this village boy is from Delhi or Mumbai.] Speaker A: Wah bhaiya, app ka naam humein bhi batao. [Wow brother, tell us the app's name too.] Speaker B: Likh lo behen, PW Talk. [Write it down sister, PW Talk.] Voiceover: English speaking seekhna hai to PW Talk app abhi download karo. [If you want to learn English speaking, download the PW Talk app now.]
